def render(t):
    # Geometry-only illustrative test, not a scientifically calibrated prism.
    u = max(0.0, min(1.0, (t - 1.0) / 3.0))
    parts = ['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="540" viewBox="0 0 960 540">', '<rect width="960" height="540" fill="#f5f4ed"/>', '<path d="M410 145 L335 340 L520 340 Z" fill="none" stroke="#28312f" stroke-width="5"/>', '<path d="M120 255 L380 255" stroke="#827d6e" stroke-width="7"/>']
    for i, color in enumerate(['#bf4438', '#bd8239', '#a1a043', '#56876c', '#4f77a6', '#785c9e']):
        x = 455 + 340 * u
        y = 255 + (i - 2.5) * 31 * u
        parts.append(f'<path d="M455 255 L{x:.3f} {y:.3f}" fill="none" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="5"/>')
    return ''.join(parts) + '</svg>'
